flags: Top of p47 is the tail of p46's year-A Benedictus antiphon 'Cum esset desponsata' (continues, no row). Tail compared with the two candidates: engraving 'est' (ta EST in) is 3 notes (Verona 11680 est(hji); Dominican 5631 has 4, h!iji), 'tu' of 'Spiritu' is 3 notes (11680 tu(hji); 5631 tu(h!iji) 4 notes), final 'est' = complex neume hiHGhg in both. Verona 11680 confirmed; p46's choice stands.
The year-B antiphon 'Quomodo fiet istud' begins at the foot of p47 and continues on p48 (printed text ends 'et virtus Altissimi obumbrabit'); the c antiphon is expected on p48.
